rationale: A unanimous, narrow reversal/remand is most likely, with the Court holding Rogers does not displace ordinary Lanham Act analysis when the challenged use functions as the defendant’s own source identifier, and emphasizing the TDRA’s "designation of source" limitation for parody. Roberts is best positioned to write an institutional, administrable opinion, with some chance of a Gorsuch (textual) or Kagan (speech-sensitive) concurrence to clarify the statutory/First Amendment boundary.
